title: Librarian Agents: Training LLMs to Curate Long-Context Workspaces that Anticipate Future Queries
abstract: arXiv:2610.22273v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Reasoning over long document contexts remains a challenge for large language models (LLMs). Standard retrieval methods are inherently reactive, bottlenecking agents with complex, cross-document reasoning at inference time, while precomputed structures like knowledge graphs often fall short because they rely on rigid heuristics. Instead, can we allow agents to perform anticipatory directed curation: learning to proactively reorganize unstructured corpora prior to inference to efficiently serve diverse future queries. We build on a key asymmetry in modern agentic harnesses (e.g., Claude Code): while LLM agents are adept at navigating existing filesystems to solve an immediate task, they are rarely trained to construct reusable workspaces for future use. translated_title: 图书馆员智能体：训练大语言模型构建能预判未来查询的长上下文工作区
translated_abstract: 对长文档上下文进行推理仍然是大语言模型（LLM）面临的一项挑战。标准的检索方法本质上是被动式的，在推理时会限制智能体进行复杂的跨文档推理，而知识图谱等预计算结构往往因依赖僵化的启发式规则而效果不佳。由此引出一个问题：我们能否让智能体执行“预见性的定向策划”——学习在推理之前主动重组非结构化语料库，以便高效地服务于多样化的未来查询。我们基于现代智能体框架（如 Claude Code）中的一个关键不对称性：虽然 LLM 智能体善于在现有文件系统中导航以完成即时任务，但它们很少被训练去构建可供未来复用的工作区。为了实现这一能力，我们提出了图书馆员智能体，这是一个框架，其中构建者智能体将原始文档转换为由合成文件和引用组成的分层文件系统……
tldr: 该论文提出“图书馆员智能体”框架，训练大语言模型在推理之前主动将非结构化语料库重组为可复用的分层文件系统工作区，从而预先组织信息以高效应对未来多样化的查询需求。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes Librarian Agents, a framework that trains LLMs to proactively reorganize unstructured corpora into reusable hierarchical filesystem workspaces before inference, anticipating and efficiently serving diverse future queries.
